ticker_news.title: US Stocks Remains On Edge Ahead Of Flurry Of Earnings From Lockheed Martin, GM And Others: This Is Still A 'Buy The Dip' Market, Says Expert
ticker_news.description: US stocks remain cautious ahead of earnings reports from major companies like Lockheed Martin, GM, and others. However, an expert believes this is still a 'buy the dip' market, with positive sentiment around AI stocks and expectations of strong earnings growth.
ticker_news.author: Rounak Jain
